# AZRAR SYSTEMS

Windows desktop software for real estate and rental management. Data is local by default; optional sync and integrations use network access when used. Arabic and English interfaces. 30-day trial. Annual licensing. SQL Server sync is available in every plan, subject to licensed device counts.

## Lessons
The 14 actual recordings have Arabic on-screen instructions and no voice-over. English page titles describe these same Arabic recordings; they are not English-translated videos. Some recordings are field-and-tab tours and do not save a completed transaction.
